title.zh: OKX推出OKX Money自托管金融应用，覆盖30多国并支持50余种货币兑换稳定币
title.en: OKX debuts a platform that turns 50 currencies into digital dollars, betting emerging market investors want stablecoins

current_state.zh: OKX推出OKX Money，这是一款基于X Layer构建的独立自托管金融应用，在30多个国家提供转账、消费、储蓄和资产托管服务，为欧洲用户提供由Aave支持的Pay Boost，并计划推出AI驱动的投资功能。
current_state.en: OKX unveiled OKX Money, a standalone self-custodial finance app built on X Layer offering transfers, spending, savings and asset custody across more than 30 countries, with Aave-backed Pay Boost for European users and planned AI-driven investment features.

updates.title_zh: OKX推出将50种货币兑换为数字美元的平台，押注新兴市场投资者想要稳定币
updates.title_en: OKX debuts a platform that turns 50 currencies into digital dollars, betting emerging market investors want stablecoins
updates.what_changed_zh: OKX已推出一个将50种当地货币兑换为数字美元的平台，押注新兴市场投资者将采用稳定币进行储蓄和跨境支付。
updates.what_changed_en: OKX has launched a platform that converts 50 local currencies into digital dollars, betting that emerging-market investors will adopt stablecoins for savings and cross-border payments.
updates.current_state_zh: OKX已推出一个将50种当地货币兑换为数字美元的平台，押注新兴市场投资者将采用稳定币进行储蓄和跨境支付。
updates.current_state_en: OKX has launched a platform that converts 50 local currencies into digital dollars, betting that emerging-market investors will adopt stablecoins for savings and cross-border payments.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OKX has launched a platform that converts 50 local currencies into digital dollars, betting that emerging-market investors will adopt stablecoins for savings and cross-border payments.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OKX has launched a platform that converts 50 local currencies into digital dollars, betting that emerging-market investors will adopt stablecoins for savings and cross-border payments.

updates.title_zh: OKX以提供收益的稳定币储蓄和支付应用瞄准新兴市场
updates.title_en: OKX eyes emerging markets with yield-offering stablecoin savings and payments app
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道确认该平台名为 OKX Money，并补充：用户可将 50 多种货币存入并转换为 USDG、USDC 或 USDT；符合条件的 USDG 余额可获最高 10% APY；提供虚拟或实体消费卡；在拉丁美洲、非洲、南亚和中东按市场逐步推出。
updates.what_changed_en: The story confirms the platform is OKX Money and adds: deposits from 50+ currencies convert into USDG, USDC or USDT; eligible USDG balances can earn up to 10% APY; virtual or physical spending cards are offered; rollout is market-by-market in Latin America, Africa, South Asia and the Middle East.
updates.current_state_zh: OKX 已推出 OKX Money，在部分新兴市场提供稳定币储蓄和支付服务，支持 50 多种货币兑换为 USDG、USDC 或 USDT，符合条件的 USDG 余额最高可获 10% APY，并提供虚拟或实体消费卡，按市场逐步推广。
updates.current_state_en: OKX has launched OKX Money in selected emerging markets for stablecoin savings and payments, supporting conversion from 50+ currencies into USDG, USDC or USDT, offering up to 10% APY on eligible USDG balances and virtual or physical spending cards, with a market-by-market rollout.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OKX launched OKX Money, a stablecoin savings and payments app in Latin America, Africa, South Asia and the Middle East that converts deposits from 50+ currencies into USDG, USDC or USDT and pays up to 10% APY on eligible USDG balances with virtual or physical spending cards.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OKX launched OKX Money, a stablecoin savings and payments app in Latin America, Africa, South Asia and the Middle East that converts deposits from 50+ currencies into USDG, USDC or USDT and pays up to 10% APY on eligible USDG balances with virtual or physical spending cards.
